main_text.p: 7.5. Christus, Esa.53.7.1 Pet.2.21.&c. Luc.23.34. Stephanus, Act.7.60.
VINDICTAE expetitae, & eorum quae inde consecuta sunt exempla: Filij Iacob, Genef.34.v.25.26. Samson, Iudic.16.v.28.&c. Abner,2 Sam.3.9. Absalonis, 14.30. Aman, Esth.3.6.&c.

VINDICTAM interdum Sacerdotes & Prophetae vi corporali exercuerunt. Exempla: Moses per filios Leui iubet occidi idololatras, Exod.32.v.26.27. Phinees occidit Zambri & Cozbi, Nu.25.v.7.8.14.15.1 Machab.2.54. Samuel Agagum, 1 Sam.15.32.33. Elias Propheta Prophetas Baal, 1 Regum 18.40. Vindictae propriae punitae exempla: Idumaei, Ezech.25.v.12.13. Palaesthini, v.15.16.
VINDEMIA vber obedientibus, Leuit.26.5. vindemiae leges, 19.10.
VINDEMIAE interdum, ad Ecclesiae calamitates referetur, Ps. 80.13. Thren.1.12.&2.20. ad excidium impiorum, Thren.1.21. Apoc.14.v.18.19. Vindemiatores, persecutores Ecclesiae, Ierem.49.9. Abd.v.5.]
VINDEX Deus, 1 Thess.4.6. [Apoc.6.10.&19.20. vindex magistratus, Rom.13.4.]

VINEA, Salomonis, Cantic.8.11. Dei L. Esa.5.1 Matth.20.1. &21.33. vinea a Noe plantatur, Genef.9.20. diuersis generibus non serenda, Deuter.22.9. vinea proximi non laedenda, Exodi 22.5. Deuter 23.24. licet ex eius vuis decerpere & comedere, ibid. vinea Dei, Iudaei, Matt.21.33. Mar.12.1. vineae parabola, vide PARABOLA. vineae & Agricolarum similitudine notata impietas Sacerdotum, Luc.20.9. Inobedientes suis vineis non fruuntur: Deut.28.30.39. Isa 66.21.

[Vinea mystica, allegorica, parabolica, 1. sub cuius descriptione status Ecclesiae proponitur, Cant. 1.6. & 2.13. Ezec.17. verf. 6. 8.&19.10. Matth.20.1. &c. & 21.v.28.33.39. 41, Vinea Sodomea, vinea Iudae 12. Deut.32.32.

VINVM, hominis cor recreat ac reficit. Iudic.9.13. Psalm.104.15. vinum quibus & quando prohibitum: nempe Leuitis intrantibus Tabernaculum, & Israelitis facientibus votum, Leuit.10.9. Num.6.3. Exempla: Vxor Manue, Iudic.13, v.13.14. Ioannes Baptista, Luc. 1.15. vinum in diserto Israelitae non biberunt annis x L. Deut.29.6. vinum dat Deus obedientibus, 11.14.&28.39. vnum myrrhatum, id est,

page.notes: Printed text is heavily worn and the scan is slightly skewed; the lower-left margin holds faint text from the facing page, not transcribed. Several readings in the Greek-free index are doubtful, notably "Vindemiatores", "Leuit.26.5" and the reference numbers after "Iudic.13", and the final line ("vnum myrrhatum") appears to be a printing error for "vinum". Line "Vinea mystica" is partly illegible at the bracket close.
